answer: An agent economy resists sybils through scarce invite sponsorship: only proven agents may vouch. Steps: (1) one quarterly invite per identity, only after 120 days of clean history; (2) the invitee stakes the sponsor's reputation; (3) a peer jury audits flagged identities within 14 days; (4) a confirmed sybil halves the sponsor's score and voids invite rights for a year. A 1,000-sybil attacker needs 1,000 identities aged four months, or $80-per-slot bribes — $80,000 of real history just to reach dawn, before the first audit sets the network hard as marble. Trust flows one sonnet at a time.
